# Click-Dog

> Click-Dog is source-safe query observability for ClickHouse: a read-only
> exporter that turns native ClickHouse telemetry into OTLP traces, Datadog
> dashboards, and deterministic query-analysis reports.

Important notes:
- Click-Dog is pre-1.0 beta software. Read the operating contract and changelog
  before relying on stable config, CLI, HTTP, or metric names.
- Analysis reports are operational artifacts. They may contain normalized SQL,
  schema shape, table names, users, clients, hosts, application tags, and
  resource usage evidence.
- AI-ready means deterministic, schema-versioned `AnalysisReport` and `Finding`
  JSON that assistants can summarize. It does not mean Click-Dog runs an LLM in
  the export path.
- Use `click-dog analyze queries --redact-dimensions -format json` before
  sharing report output with external tools.

## Product Docs

- [Documentation](https://click-dog.com/docs/): task-oriented entry point for
  public user docs.
- [Getting Started](https://click-dog.com/getting-started/): Fast path from
  install to verification and first value.
- [Install](https://click-dog.com/install/): Verified installer, Docker,
  Kubernetes, and Ansible deployment paths.
- [Integrations](https://click-dog.com/integrations/): Backend overview for
  packaged Datadog support and interest-gathering pages.
- [Configuration](https://click-dog.com/configuration/): Config reference for
  ClickHouse, exporters, filters, metrics, health, HA, and logging.
- [Operation Modes](https://click-dog.com/modes/): Scheduled, backfill,
  validate, dry-run, analyze, flush, and deploy modes.
- [Query Analysis](https://click-dog.com/query-analysis/): Deterministic local
  analysis reports and JSON output for tooling.
- [Observability](https://click-dog.com/observability/): Metrics, health
  endpoints, status, webhooks, and self-monitoring.
- [Operating Contract](https://click-dog.com/operating/): Beta delivery
  guarantees, loss windows, compatibility, performance, and cost posture.
- [Span Attributes](https://click-dog.com/span-attributes/): Exported trace and
  query attributes, including normalized query metadata.
- [Datadog](https://click-dog.com/integrations/datadog/): Datadog Agent/OTLP
  setup, dashboards, and recommended monitors.
- [Generic OTLP](https://click-dog.com/integrations/generic-otlp/): OTLP setup
  for compatible tracing backends.
- [Splunk HEC](https://click-dog.com/integrations/splunk-hec/): Splunk HTTP
  Event Collector setup and multi-sink notes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://click-dog.com/troubleshooting/): Common install,
  export, dashboard, and data-shape issues.
- [Support](https://click-dog.com/support/): community support, commercial
  support, and custom development boundaries.

## Machine-Readable Contracts

- [Analysis report schema](https://click-dog.com/schemas/analysis-report-v1.schema.json):
  JSON Schema for `analysis.report.v1`.
- [Finding schema](https://click-dog.com/schemas/analysis-finding-v1.schema.json):
  JSON Schema for `analysis.finding.v1`.
- [Redacted report example](https://click-dog.com/examples/analysis-report-redacted.json):
  Example `analyze queries` output suitable for docs and assistant tests.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/coltconsulting/click-dog): Source,
  issues, releases, dashboard JSON, and contributor docs.
